prompt_preview:
You are a consultant at Tessera Advisory (a fictional firm) writing a proposal deck for Falaj Health Partners on "Patient Experience and Clinical Operations Transformation".
Write the text for EXACTLY 16 slides, following each brief closely.
Rules:
- Confident consulting language in your OWN words.

slides.title: Patient Experience and Clinical Operations Transformation: proposal to Falaj Health Partners
bullets: Submitted by Tessera Advisory
October 2026
slides.notes: Opening slide for the proposal submission.

slides.title: About Tessera Advisory
bullets: We are a boutique firm focused on high-impact operational change.
Our firm maintains ISO 27001 certification for information security.
Protecting data entrusted to us is one of our core values.
slides.notes: Overview of firm capabilities and security posture.

slides.title: Our understanding
bullets: Falaj Health Partners faces increasing pressure from rising patient expectations.
Facility density currently exceeds optimal capacity levels.
Staff shortages are impacting service consistency across the network.
slides.notes: Reflecting the current operational context of the client.

slides.title: Our approach
bullets: Listen: We capture deep insights from stakeholders and patients.
Measure: We validate performance gaps using rigorous data analysis.
Design: We architect modern solutions for patient and staff experience.
Mobilise: We support the transition to new operating models.

slides.title: Phase 1: Listen
bullets: Map end-to-end care pathways across all sixteen facilities.
Conduct sixty-plus sessions gathering feedback from patients and staff.
Identify friction points within clinical and operational workflows.

slides.title: Phase 2: Measure
bullets: Examine appointment delays for all outpatient services.
Quantify queue lengths using two years of historical records.
Provide a baseline of operational throughput for outpatient settings.
slides.notes: Focusing on data-driven analysis of outpatient flows.

slides.title: Phase 3: Design the digital experience
bullets: Develop requirements for a seamless online appointment booking platform.
Create a patient mobile app to enhance service interaction.
Simplify access to care via digital touchpoints.
slides.notes: Digital design focus for patient experience.

slides.title: Phase 3: Design the workforce model
bullets: Engineer a robust system for managing clinical staff rotations.
Align shift patterns to forecasted patient demand volumes.
Improve workforce distribution to ensure coverage across facilities.

slides.title: Programme leadership
bullets: Establish an executive steering board for high-level oversight.
Review performance indicators through monthly leadership meetings.
Ensure alignment on a balanced scorecard of success metrics.

slides.title: Building capability
bullets: Launch a dedicated training academy for nursing staff.
Deliver targeted skill development at the four primary hospitals.
Empower nursing teams with advanced operational knowledge.
slides.notes: Capability building for the nursing workforce.

slides.title: What you will receive
bullets: Comprehensive baseline report on patient experience and operations.
Prioritized sequence of initiatives for future implementation.
Live performance cockpit transferred to your internal technology team.
slides.notes: Outlining the final outputs of the engagement.

slides.title: Workplan
bullets: The total engagement duration is 20 weeks.
Mid-programme readout of results occurs in week 10.
Status updates provided every Thursday to the executive sponsor.

slides.title: Your team
bullets: Lead Partner: Strategic oversight and executive alignment.
Clinical Advisor: Former hospital CMO with 15 years experience.
Transformation Lead: Expert in operational efficiency and systems.
Experience Architect: Specialist in digital patient interactions.
Analyst: Data science lead fluent in English and Arabic.

slides.title: Commercial proposal
bullets: Proposed fixed fee covers the total scope of engagement.
Payment schedule aligned to defined milestones.
Invoices are payable within 30 days of contract award.

slides.title: Relevant experience
bullets: Client references are available upon request.
Proprietary benchmarking database covers 200+ hospitals globally.
Our firm maintains a library of successful healthcare transformations.
slides.notes: Demonstrating firm credibility and benchmarking reach.

slides.title: Why Tessera and next steps
bullets: Deep expertise in healthcare operations and patient experience.
Proven methodology tailored to facility-wide transformation.
Collaborative approach ensuring internal team ownership.
We invite you to a follow-up meeting next week.
